summary: Frontend-only testing of /provvigioni list-save/pay flow and /contabilita brogliaccio for Axicura/Schiantarelli CRM. All 5 flows passed: (1) salva lista hides selected titoli, (2) card 'Liste salvate da pagare' shows new bozza with Paga/Carica/elimina controls, (3) paga lista opens pre-populated dialog, payment registered with auto-saved ritenuta, bozza deleted after payment, (4) brogliaccio row for 'Pagamento provvigioni' shows RITENUTA column EMPTY, SPESE=49,98€, banca CREDIT AGRICOLE=-49,98€ as required, (5) elimina bozza restores titoli to main table.

integration_issues.issue: Immediately after 'Registra pagamento' the Storico pagamenti card shows '0 pagamenti registrati / Nessun pagamento' until the collaboratore is reselected/refreshed. Data persists correctly (verified via brogliaccio), so it is a client-side refresh issue only.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - add DialogDescription for a11y compliance.

action_items: Optional: refresh/refetch Storico pagamenti list in the Provvigioni page immediately after a payment is registered via 'Paga lista' (currently the Storico stays empty until a re-selection of the collaboratore).
Optional a11y: add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to the Paga collaboratore DialogContent to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend logic (verified via brogliaccio UI output): _compute_brogliaccio correctly maps provvigioni-uscita with c_ritenuta=0 and c_spese=importo; banca uscita is correctly resolved from tipo_pagamento. No regression observed.
Frontend: Provvigioni.jsx correctly filters out r.in_bozza / v.in_bozza entries from the main tables and renders the Liste salvate card with paga/carica/elimina controls.
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_LISTA_<ts> bozza (consumed by payment, then deleted) and a TEST_DEL_LIST bozza (deleted during elimina test). No residual test data remains in liste salvate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 user-requested behaviors (ritenuta vuota nel brogliaccio, paga lista salvata, titoli nascosti durante bozza) sono funzionanti end-to-end. Collaboratore di test con molti titoli: 'BS BROKER SAS DI VANOLI LUCIA E C.' su tenant c5ae2d0e-... Login QA tester attivo.
